item.title: What did your mapper actually do? Now you can ask it.
item.description:
Telescope, part 3 of 3: how it got built · why your mappings should not be strings · asking your mapper what it did

The setup

A field arrives null in production. The mapper between your entity and your DTO is the suspect, and now you get to answer a simple question: what did it actually map?

If the mapper is MapStruct, the answer lives in one place: the generated *MapperImpl.java under build/generated. You open it, you read the assignments, you diff what you read against what you meant. If the question is about a specific request — which values went in, which came out — generated source cannot answer it at all; you add a breakpoint or a log line, redeploy, and wait for the bug to happen again.
